name: Luna 17

narrator.name: Lunokhod 1
narrator.role: the first robot car on the Moon

intro: Beep beep! I'm Lunokhod 1, the first remote-controlled car on another world.
Eight wheels, a bathtub-shaped body and a lid full of solar cells.
Drivers on Earth steer me with a few seconds of delay. Imagine driving a car with your eyes closed!
First, my lander Luna 17 needs a good parking spot.
briefing: We are over Mare Imbrium, the Sea of Showers.
Choose a site with sunshine for my solar panels and Earth in view for my drivers.
fact: Lunokhod 1 drove over 10 km and worked for almost a year.
